t: Not to exceed $285,000 shall be available for administrative expenses, which shall be on an accrual basis and shall be exclusive of interest paid, depreciation, properly capitalized expenditures, expenses in connection with liquidation of insured institutions or preparation for or conduct of proceedings under section 407 or 408 of the National Housing Act, liquidation or handling of, assets of or derived from insured institutions, payment of insurance, and action for or toward the avoidance, termination, or minimizing of losses in the case of insured institutions, legal fees and expenses, and payments for expenses of the Federal Home Loan Bank Board determined by said Board to be properly allocable to said Corporation, and said Corporation may utilize and may make payment for services and facilities of the Federal home-loan banks, the Federal Reserve banks, the Federal Home Loan Bank Board, and other agencies of the Government: Provided, That, notwithstanding any other provisions of this Act, except for the limitation in amount hereinbefore specified, the administrative expenses and other obligations of said Corporation shall be incurred, allowed and paid in accordance with title IV of the Act of June 27, 1934, as amended (12 U.S.C. 1724–1730a).

fable.w: This is an appropriations limitation on a federal corporation's administrative expenses, with rules on how those expenses are counted and paid. The tempting reading is that "proceedings under section 407 or 408" or the use of services of the Federal home-loan banks and Federal Reserve banks implies outside involvement. That reading fails because these are only expense categories and service arrangements, not consultation, hearings, rulemaking, or a right for any outside party to take part in or challenge a federal decision.
fable.s: Not to exceed $285,000 shall be available for administrative expenses

qwen_block.w: This section details administrative expenses and authorizes the Corporation to use services from other federal agencies (Federal home-loan banks, Federal Reserve banks, etc.). All entities mentioned are part of the federal government. There is no consultation, coordination, or participation with outside parties such as the public, states, or private entities.
qwen_block.s: said Corporation may utilize and may make payment for services and facilities of the Federal home-loan banks, the Federal Reserve banks, the Federal Home Loan Bank Board, and other agencies of the Government

opus.w: This is an appropriations limit on the Corporation's administrative expenses, with a list of costs that don't count toward the cap. The section mentions proceedings under sections 407 or 408 only to exclude their costs; it doesn't create or grant any hearing, comment period, or right for outsiders to object. The services the Corporation may use come from federal bodies, which is coordination within the government. No one outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.
opus.s: Not to exceed $285,000 shall be available for administrative expenses
opus.b:
1. **Tempting reading:** The section mentions "proceedings under section 407 or 408 of the National Housing Act" and lets the Corporation use "services and facilities" of other bodies, so it could look like an outside-party process. That reading fails. The proceedings are named only to exclude their costs from the spending cap; this section creates no hearing or right to object. The services the Corporation may use all come from federal bodies (the Federal home-loan banks, Federal Reserve banks, the Federal Home Loan Bank Board, "and other agencies of the Government"). That is coordination inside the government.

qwen_chat.w: The section describes administrative expenses and the utilization of services from other federal agencies (Federal home-loan banks, Federal Reserve banks, etc.). All entities mentioned are part of the federal government. There is no requirement or recommendation to consult with or coordinate with any party outside the federal government, such as states, tribes, or the public.
qwen_chat.s: said Corporation may utilize and may make payment for services and facilities of the Federal home-loan banks, the Federal Reserve banks, the Federal Home Loan Bank Board, and other agencies of the Government
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that the phrase "services and facilities of... other agencies of the Government" implies coordination with outside entities. However, the text explicitly lists "Federal home-loan banks, the Federal Reserve banks, the Federal Home Loan Bank Board," which are all federal or quasi-federal entities. The phrase "other agencies of the Government" reinforces that the interaction is strictly within the federal government. There is no mention of consulting with states, tribes, the public, or private companies.
